description: A tall, lean, dark-skinned early human with a heavy brow and short hair strides left across an open savanna at dusk. He is shirtless, wears a ragged hide wrap at the waist, and holds a stone handaxe in one hand. Flat-topped acacia-like trees and low hills sit on a wide horizon under a dark, streaky sky. The painting is oil-like and fills the whole square with no frame or text visible.
